market_summary: The late New York session is characterized by late-day range compression across all asset classes. Metals (XAUUSD, XAGUSD), FX (EURUSD, GBPUSD), and Crypto (BTCUSD) remain pinned in macro downtrends well below their respective daily VWAPs and Value Areas, yet are consolidating above session lows on declining tick volume without expansion catalysts. Concurrently, US100 remains in a positive dampening options regime above VWAP but pulled back immediately upon testing Call Wall #1 (28431). With volume fading and prices stuck mid-channel, no valid 7-point confluence triggers exist across the board.

signals.rationale: Price is trading below VAL (3893.78) and below POC (3978.13). CVD is -7.38 (BEARISH) with a slightly positive slope (+0.9) reflecting a minor counter-trend pause. In the NEW_YORK_SESSION, price remains firmly below session VWAP (3933.36) and the structural EMA50 baseline (3914.54). Positioned mid-channel between the lower ATR band (3865.07) and EMA20 baseline (3885.58). Volume is sub-average with RVOL at 0.788 showing no expansion spike. GEX is in a POSITIVE_DAMPENING regime with price above Gamma Flip (3870.11), bounded between dealer support at Put Wall #1 (3820.33) and resistance far above at Call Wall #1 (4147.79). Given dealer dampening and mid-range consolidation above Session Low (3852.35), setup warrants a HOLD.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish below downward-sloping VWAP and EMA50

signals.rationale: Price is positioned below VAL (1.10708) and below POC (1.10942). During the NEW_YORK_SESSION, price trades well beneath both VWAP (1.10785) and EMA50 (1.10753), maintaining a bearish macro trend. Candles are hovering right above the lower ATR band (1.10484) after an intraday sweep of Session Low (1.10457). Volume remains subdued with RVOL at 0.776 without yellow spike confirmation. Lacking momentum breakout or clean reversal structure, staying flat.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish below downward-sloping VWAP and EMA50

signals.rationale: Price is located below VAL (1.32438) and below POC (1.32731). CVD is -5,560 (BEARISH) though showing a positive short-term delta slope (+3157.58) indicating absorption off lows. RVOL at 1.538 is elevated but lacks the required >2.0 breakout spike. Confluence is mixed between trend and bottoming wick, favoring HOLD.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish below downward-sloping VWAP and EMA50

signals.rationale: Price is positioned above VAH (28244.33) and above POC (28122.95). CVD is NEUTRAL (+2.05) with a flat slope (+0.13). In the NEW_YORK_SESSION, trend is structurally bullish above rising VWAP (28177.99) and EMA50 (28230.63). Price is situated mid-channel between EMA20 (28310.86) and upper ATR band (28513.69). RVOL is 0.873 (noting the index CFD tick volume caveat). In the GEX structure, the regime is POSITIVE_DAMPENING above Gamma Flip (28307.78). Price spiked into Call Wall #1 (28431.17) and was promptly rejected, respecting dealer dampening behavior. Buying directly into the Call Wall is prohibited, and selling counters the VWAP trend. Prudent action is HOLD.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bullish above upward-sloping VWAP and EMA50

Currently hovering right at the EMA20 baseline (50.197) in mid-channel after bouncing off Session Low (49.688). Volume is quiet with RVOL at 0.769, 17 bars removed from the last yellow spike. With price sitting in no-man's-land without an active level test or expansion trigger, discipline dictates HOLD.

Range-bound compression following a large drop warrants a HOLD.
